hook_text: Your ticket says 17:30. Is that 7:30 in the evening? Not even close.
clip_script: Kagiso's bus from Gqeberha to Cape Town. The station clock: minute hand on the 9, hour hand nearly at the 8. That is 7:45, quarter to eight, not 8:45. His watch: 7:45 a.m. Morning. The bus arrives at 5:30 p.m. The ticket says 17:30. After noon, add 12: 5 plus 12 is 17. Going back? 17 minus 12 is 5, so 5:30 p.m. Midnight is 00:00. Every clock, same moment.
visual_style: An analogue station clock, a digital watch and a printed ticket all lighting up with the same time.
mood: Busy and confident, like a traveller who never misses a bus.
pacing: The analogue trap, the a.m. and p.m. switch, then the 24-hour conversion.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write today's school times in 24-hour time.
